candidate.answerReason: The rectangle's dimensions are 110% and 90% of the square's side, so its area is 99% of the square's area.

methods.label: Choose a convenient length unit
methods.explanation:
Use one tenth of the square's side as the common unit of length. Its side then measures \(10\), and its area is \(10\cdot10=100\) square units.

Since \(10\%=1/10\), ten percent of the square's side is \(1\) unit. The rectangle therefore has length \(11\) and width \(9\), giving area
\[
11\cdot9=99
\]
square units. Both areas use the same unit, so their ratio is \(99:100\), choice A.
methods.levelReason: The solution uses only percentages, whole-number multiplication, and elementary area formulas.
